name: How long does a typical door latch repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door latch repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard door latch repairs can be completed within 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on the complexity of the issue and the type of latch. More involved repairs, such as those requiring new parts or intricate mechanism adjustments, might take longer. We aim to complete repairs efficiently to minimize disruption to your home or business.
